We all know the normal resin shipment is delayed and there's an alternate resin available from an existing industrial supplier. Since this alternate hasn't been used in this housing line's regular production before, I need input from each of you. Process engineering: what do we know about this alternate resin's behavior in our process? Materials logistics: what's the availability and timing? Customer compliance: are there any approval or specification concerns? I'll make the final call on whether we proceed and what controls we put in place.
